Some posts can only be downloaded while logged in. Tap Log in with browser and log in to the site inside Murem, or import a cookies.txt file (Netscape format) exported from a browser on a computer. The cookies are stored only on this device and are sent with every link in Internal mode, for all sites. YouTube downloads may change if YouTube cookies are included. Anyone who has these cookies can use your account: never share them, and tap Remove to delete them when you are done.
